outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: The Challenge of Extended Context in Large Language Models
outline.description: This chapter introduces the motivation behind LongRoPE, addressing the limitations of current Large Language Models (LLMs) when dealing with context lengths beyond 128k tokens. It outlines the three major obstacles to extending context windows and sets the stage for why a new approach is necessary.
subtopics: The importance of large context windows in LLM applications (e.g., In-Context Learning, Agents).
The limitation of current best practices: why extended contexts stop at ~128k tokens.
Obstacle 1: Catastrophic Values and Out-of-Distribution Issues from untrained position indices.
Obstacle 2: Scarcity of long training data and prohibitive computational costs.
Obstacle 3: Attention dispersion causing performance degradation on short sequences.
Overview of existing Positional Interpolation techniques (PI, NTK, YaRN) and their ceiling.

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2: Understanding Positional Embeddings and Interpolation
outline.description: A pedagogical deep-dive into Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) as used in modern architectures like LLaMA and Mistral. This chapter establishes the mathematical foundation required to understand LongRoPE's core innovation.
subtopics: How Transformers use positional encoding: Moving from Fixed Masks to RoPE.
Mathematical formulation of RoPE tokens and rotation angles ($n	heta_i$).
Linear Positional Interpolation (PI): Downsampling and its crowding issues.
NTK-based Interpolation and Extrapolation: The concept of information preserving scaling.
